description: CVEs whose EPSS exploitation probability rose the most recently. window is "7d" (default) or "30d". Each rise is measured between same-EPSS-model-version scores, so a model release (which shifts the whole distribution) never appears as a mover. A rise raises the priority of a CVE; observed exploitation is recorded through CISA KEV. Returns cve_id, current score, the delta, KEV status and url, largest rise first.
name: get_epss_movers
